484 / 484S: Cortech Endurance Wedge Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-484-endurance-wedge-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/endurance-wedge-table/
Spec sheet: 484 / 484S
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Wedge Table – 484 / 484S
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wedge Table - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded End and Corner Table for Dayrooms and Lounges, with Optional Ballast Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 484 / 484S Endurance Wedge Table
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Wedge Table is a compact, angled end and corner table for dayrooms, lounges, and shared spaces in behavioral healthcare, correctional, and other secure facilities. Its wedge shape fits beside chairs or between seating groups, and it can be combined with any seating style.
The table is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components and no seams to tamper with. It can be bolted to the floor with the optional bolt-down kit, and the 484S has underside ballast doors for adding weight with sandbags. The Wedge Table is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 27”W×19”D×16½”H
Weight: 13 lbs
Ballast: The 484S has underside ballast doors for adding weight with sandbags, secured with tamper-resistant screws
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
484 – Standard: Without access door, 13 lbs
484S – With Access Door: Underside ballast doors for adding sandbags
484KIT – Bolt-Down Kit: Floor attachment for bolting the Wedge Table to the floor with hardware of your choice, sold separately
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the optional bolt-down kit and hardware of your choice
Ballast: Add sandbags through the 484S ballast doors; Cortech says not to use loose sand
[H2] Applications
The Wedge Table suits dayrooms and lounges where a small table has to fit beside chairs or into corners and stand up to hard daily use.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms and lounges in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dayrooms and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Waiting rooms and residential treatment centers
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Endurance Wedge Table - 484 / 484S at Anchortex
Meta description (152 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Wedge Table. A one-piece molded end and corner table for dayrooms and lounges, with optional ballast doors and bolt-down kit.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model," and added the 484S.
Weight: your 484 and 484S variants are set to 18 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 13 lbs, so I used 13 lbs. Cortech does not give a weight for the 484KIT; your variant is set to 5 lbs.
Price: the 484S (with access door) is priced at $94.40 (compare-at $118), the same as the 484KIT bolt-down kit, while the 484 standard table is $387.20. The 484S price looks like it was copied from the kit. Can you check it?
Bolt-down kit: the Cortech spec sheet calls it an optional bolt-down kit but does not give it a model number. I kept your 484KIT.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "Raised edge for effortless clean up," since the Cortech spec sheet for the Wedge Table does not say this.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says this table is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has 13 images, one for each of the 12 older colors plus a color chart. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
